exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Multi-Type Processor
exercises.description: Get 3 inputs: name(str), score(int from str), active(bool from str 'True'/'False'). Print formatted output.
exercises.starterCode: # Get three inputs and convert types\n# Print: Name: [name] | Score: [score] | Active: [active]
exercises.solution:
name = input()
score = int(input())
active_str = input()
active = active_str == 'True'
print(f"Name: {name} | Score: {score} | Active: {active}")
